title: F1 pit stop record vs average human reaction time
notes: Human Benchmark's aggregate reaction-time test data (millions of attempts) puts the median human visual reaction time at 273 milliseconds (~0.27s). McLaren's 2023 F1 pit stop record (jack up, four wheels off and on, jack down, release), per Guinness World Records, was 1.80 seconds -- under seven of those reaction times.
